gloss: way of speaking; manner of speech

definitions.gloss: way of speaking; manner of speech; how one talks
definitions.explanation: The style, tone, or manner in which a person speaks. Encompasses word choice, speed, intonation, and overall delivery. Composed of 話し (speaking) + 方 (way/method).

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}の{話|はな}し{方|かた}はとても{丁寧|ていねい}だ。
examples.english: Her way of speaking is very polite.

examples.japanese: {話|はな}し{方|かた}ひとつで{印象|いんしょう}が{大|おお}きく{変|か}わる。
examples.english: The impression you make changes dramatically with how you speak.

examples.japanese: {上司|じょうし}に{対|たい}する{話|はな}し{方|かた}に{気|き}をつけたほうがいい。
examples.english: You should be careful about how you speak to your superiors.

notes:
USAGE:
{話|はな}し{方|かた} is a very common compound following the productive ～{方|かた} (way of doing ~) pattern. It can refer to both the content and delivery of speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {話|はな}し{方|かた}が{上手|じょうず} (good at speaking)
- {話|はな}し{方|かた}を{変|か}える (change one's way of speaking)
- {話|はな}し{方|かた}に{気|き}をつける (be careful about how one speaks)
- {話|はな}し{方|かた}{教室|きょうしつ} (public speaking class)
- {話|はな}し{方|かた}のコツ (tips for speaking)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{口調|くちょう} refers to the tone of voice or manner of speaking and focuses on how words sound. {言|い}い{方|かた} means "way of saying" or "phrasing" and focuses more on word choice. {話術|わじゅつ} means "art of conversation" or "eloquence."
